sq.QUESTION_DESC: Explain the steps to create a thread using the Thread class in Java.

lq.ANSWER:
Design:

  • Create FileReaderThread class extending Thread

  • Implement Compressor class using Runnable

  • Use shared object (e.g., queue) for file data

  • Use synchronized blocks or ReentrantLock to manage shared resource access

Code Snippet:

class FileReaderThread extends Thread 
{ 
private List<String> fileList; 
public FileReaderThread(List<String> files) 
{ this.fileList = files; 
} 
public void run() 
{ 
for (String file : fileList)
 { System.out.println("Reading: " + file); 
Compressor task = new Compressor(file); 
Thread t = new Thread(task); t.start(); 
} 
} 
}
 class Compressor implements Runnable 
{ 
private String file; 
public Compressor(String file) 
{ 
this.file = file; 
} 
public void run() 
{ 
System.out.println("Compressing: " + file); // Compression logic here 
} 
}
